test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sparse_column_index_sorted (a Int16, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.5
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sparse_column_index_sorted SELECT cityHash64(number) % 100 = 0 ? 1 + number % 7 : 0, intHash32(number) % 20 = 0 ? number : 0 FROM numbers(500000000)
test.query: SELECT a, count() FROM sparse_column_index_sorted WHERE a != 0 GROUP BY a FORMAT Null
